description: MANDATE-07 #7b BLIND-SPOT case #2 (latency signal): inject imageSlowLoad=5sec via flagd so image-provider serves images with a 5s delay, and show latency-p95-high does NOT fire. Measuring this case found the reason, and it is the same shape as case_cart_failure: image-provider publishes no http_server_request_duration_seconds series at all — its only timing data in Prometheus is collector-generated traces_span_metrics_duration_milliseconds, plus target_info. latency-p95-high reads http_server_request_duration_seconds_bucket, so for this service it evaluates over an empty series and can never breach the 1s SLO threshold however slow the service gets. Expected verdict is FAIL until image-provider emits server-side HTTP metrics or a latency rule is added over traces_span_metrics_*. Kept in the set so the coverage hole stays measured rather than assumed away.
